boundary_note: Kosel 24 January–14 July; conditional agreement and intended 16 July handover are not actual surrender. Tactical and campaign replacement boundaries are unset; phases are research hypotheses. No feature admission or historical rating fit.

claims.value: Bodart: side A 5,000 under Deroy, later Raglowich; side B 4,300 and 229 guns under Neumann, later Puttkammer.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "The Prussian garrison, 4,300 men with 229 guns, under Colonel von Neumann and after his death Colonel von Puttkamer, defends successfully against the Bavarian blockade corps of 5,000, initially under Lieutenant-General von Deroy and finally Major-General von Raglowich. A capitulation signed on 11 June provided for surrender on 16 July unless relieved. News of Tilsit arriving on 14 July voided the agreement, so Kosel did not fall. Only 1,100 of the garrison were then fit for duty."

citations.quote: Die preußische Besatzung (4.300 M. mit 229 Gesch.) unter Obst. v. Neumann, nach dessen Tode unter Obst. v. Puttkamer, verteidigt sich standhaft und erfolgreich gegen das bayrische Blokadekorps (5.000 M.) urspr. unter Gen.-Lt. v. Deroy, zum Schluß unter GM. v. Raglowich. Am 11. Juni wurde eine Kapitulation unterzeichnet, wonach die Festung sich am 16. Juli ergeben sollte, falls sie bis dahin nicht entsetzt würde. Die am 14. Juli eingelangte Nachricht vom Friedensschluß zu Tilsit machte die frühere Kapitulation hinfällig, so daß Kosel nicht in Feindeshand geriet. Zu diesem Zeitpunkte waren nur mehr 1.100 M. der Besatzung dienstfähig.

claims.rationale: Not 4,249 fit combatants; officers are a separate column. English rendering (ours): "total 67 officers, 4,249 men, 40 horses, including sick"

claims.value: Höpfner lists Deroy’s 5th and 10th line regiments, the 4th regiment’s second battalion and three chevauleger squadrons on the left bank; Siebein’s separate right-bank force is qualified as apparent.
claims.rationale: Formation observation, not an independent numerical people return. English rendering (ours): "On the left bank of the Oder General Deroy himself advanced with the 5th and 10th line regiments, the 4th regiment’s second battalion and three chevauleger squadrons"

claims.value: Neumann was fortress commandant and Otto engineering staff captain; Deroy directed the left-bank besiegers.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Commandant of Kosel was the 67-year-old Colonel Neumann; engineer of the place was Captain Otto." English rendering (ours): "Deroy himself advanced on the left bank with the listed formations."

citations.quote: Kommandant von Kosel war der 67 Jahr alte Oberst Neumann, Ingenieur vom Platz der Hauptmann Otto.

claims.value: Neumann delegated business temporarily to vice-commandant Puttkammer during illness, then resumed on 11 March. In July Brünnow acted during Puttkammer’s illness, but Puttkammer still issued an order from his sickbed.
claims.rationale: The surrounding p 438 account calls Brünnow the temporary acting senior staff officer and prints Puttkammer’s counter-order. Exact permanent succession date unresolved. English rendering (ours): "The commandant appointed Colonel Puttkammer vice-commandant and transferred the details of business to him for a time" English rendering (ours): "From 11 March Colonel Neumann again conducted commandant business." English rendering (ours): "Major Brünnow had convened a council of war on 11 July"

citations.quote: Der Kommandant ernannte den Obersten Puttkammer zum Vice-Kommandanten und übertrug ihm auf einige Zeit die Details der Geschäfte
Vom 11. März ab versah der Oberst Neumann wiederum die Kommandanturgeschäfte.
Major Brünnow, hatte am 11. Juli einen Kriegsrath zusammenberufen

claims.value: By 14 July Höpfner describes about 1,100 men doing duty, with fewer than twenty genuinely healthy per company.
claims.rationale: Duty strength and healthy strength differ; no numerical readiness score. English rendering (ours): "in the remaining duty garrison of about 1,100 men, fewer than twenty per company could be considered truly healthy"
